designationHistory.indexText: Congress established Bayou Cocodrie National Wildlife Refuge to protect bottomland hardwood forest.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bayou Cocodrie National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Bayou Cocodrie National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168176): "Congress authorized the establishment of Bayou Cocodrie National Wildlife Refuge on November 16, 1990, through Public Law 101-593"; "When Congress established the refuge in 1990"

review.note: Draft 1992 is wrong; CCP gives Nov. 16, 1990, P.L. 101-593 (signed by George H. W. Bush).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bayou Cocodrie National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1992, is located in Concordia Parish in east central Louisiana.
